Ideon is a self-hosted visual workspace that allows users to organize projects, notes, and tasks on an infinite canvas. It replaces traditional folder structures with spatial organization, enabling real-time collaboration and historical tracking of workspace evolution.

DomainSearcher is a free, browser-based tool that helps users find and select the best domain name for their startup. It uses AI to generate domain name candidates based on a startup idea, checks their real-time availability across various TLDs, and scores them on multiple criteria like length, pronounceability, memorability, brandability, and fit with the app idea.
